column3: I have one piece of advice for you.
At the moment, your vision is still restrained.
Such lame parroting... What a dull man you are...
J-Just save it! Let's get on with the main issue!
...Hmph. You've always seen nothing but only the old Tamura-senpai. The present Tamura-senpai is beyond your view. That is why.
It is just as I said. When ensnared by the phantasms of the past, happiness is impossible.
W-What the heck... Are you saying that... Manami and I are unhappy?
That... Would it not be something that henceforth depends on you both?
